_comment: Mutation testing scoped to the parse boundaries that guard credentials, transport reach, and canonical ordering. Line coverage proves a test executed a line; mutation score proves a test would NOTICE if that line changed. These three modules are where a silently-passing test is most dangerous, so they are the ones held to a mutation threshold. Scoped deliberately: mutating all 1670 statements of @hobo/core would take far longer than a developer will wait, and a gate nobody runs is not a gate.
